notes: Int generator state threaded explicitly through a strict IO loop, so record THREE continues where record TWO stopped; r = fromIntegral seed / 139968 is an IEEE-754 Double division.
scanl1 (+) builds the cumulative UArray Int Double in table order; pick scans it linearly for the first entry greater than r.

Each random line is filled by Data.ByteString.unfoldrN (one generator step per symbol), which also hands back the state after the line; ALU lines are zero-copy slices of ALU ++ its first 60 characters.
Lines go through hPutBuilder into a 64 KiB block-buffered stdout; ghc -O2, non-threaded RTS, fully static on a scratch image.
